findings.description: The profiling_status rustdoc names INIT and PARTIALLY_COMPLETE as response values with no declared filter, but omits QUEUED, which was also a declared response value of the old ProfilingStatus enum and was removed in 0.86.0 (contracts/vendor/red-team-management/0.86.0/compatibility-decisions.json:710-717 records old [INIT, QUEUED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, PARTIALLY_COMPLETE] vs new [NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, PARTIALLY_COMPLETE]). The field type is Patch<String> (crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs:175036-175037) so the value is preserved, but a caller whose backend still returns profiling_status=QUEUED has no in-crate statement that this response value is legacy, unfilterable and deliberately unmapped; the status rustdoc mentions QUEUED only as a query value with no successor filter.
findings.required_fix: Add QUEUED to the list of legacy response values in the profiling_status rustdoc (targets.rs:35-38), stating that responses may still carry INIT, QUEUED or PARTIALLY_COMPLETE, that no filter value is declared for them and that the SDK performs no mapping.

findings.description: The rejected-filter error is a bare crate::Error::new(crate::ErrorKind::Validation) with no operation and no indication of which parameter failed. This matches the module-wide idiom (common.rs:87-93 filter(), common.rs:105-111 uuid(), common.rs:74-76 listing()) and correctly avoids echoing caller input, but because query() validates skip/limit/search/adapter_uuid/target_type/status/profiling_status in one pass, a caller who gets a Validation error from list_pages or list_all cannot tell which of several supplied filters was refused, and pre-dispatch errors also carry operation() == None. Neither the field rustdoc nor the method rustdoc tells the caller that this single ErrorKind covers all query-parameter refusals.
findings.required_fix: Without echoing values, make the refusal distinguishable: either document on TargetListOptions (or on list/list_pages/list_all) that every unsupported query value, including an undeclared profiling_status, surfaces as ErrorKind::Validation with no remote request sent, or attach the static operation name to pre-dispatch validation errors as the send paths already do.
